title: Switch search to a new service for everyone at once

packet.text:
Move product search from our Elasticsearch cluster to the new SearchLite service.

1. Change SEARCH_BACKEND from elasticsearch to searchlite in the production config.
2. Deploy the change to every region at 09:00 on Monday.
3. Call it a success if the search API's error rate stays under 1% for the first hour.
4. On Tuesday, delete the Elasticsearch cluster to stop paying for it.
assumptions: SearchLite holds the same index as Elasticsearch.
The search API's response format doesn't change.
